title: A girl's back
logline: A girl of sixteen, not local, from behind, walking up the road east — the logging road — toward the ridge, a zine in her back pocket. The page lets her go and stays at the road's foot.

panels.composition: The foot of the logging road in August, and far up it, from behind, a girl of sixteen with a stapled zine in her back pocket walking toward the trees, small. Above the trees where the road bends: the glow, large. The page stays at the bottom of the road.

characters.pose: a girl of sixteen, from behind, far

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gravel logging road in August seen from its foot with a teenage girl far up it walking away toward the trees with a small zine in her back pocket, a large warm glow above the trees where the road bends, no words
image.notes: Vol 7's girl, from behind only. She goes toward the glow; the page doesn't.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: She goes up the road. The page stays.
